admission.justification: Treating a tooling success or missing capture as a behavioral pass would falsify model comparisons and trigger unjustified text changes.

applicability: Curator case summaries and old/new/final comparisons built from recorded eval attempts.
conditions: Attempts retain case, slot, model, text and batch identity.
Tooling checks and actor-only completions stay outside measurement arithmetic.
Infrastructure and semantic unknowns retain their causes rather than counting as right or wrong.
exclusions: Task acceptance or a new per-leaf eval gate.
Resampling a completed graded slot for a better result.

evidence: Frozen tree fd6462b85ba9d06f004e323384ea800f9aa5144a, base 59b01fb8f72a38d2d27f9c37b8b9ca2513fd3fa0; path bindings and source hashes in producer-manifest.json; Reviewer R4 and d229-repairs/report.md.

statement: Accounting keeps tooling checks, measurement outcomes, unknown causes and final-full permissions distinct instead of turning an unobserved trial into a right or wrong result.
